Lina: Heads-up: Marketplace go-live with HorizonCloud + AtlasHW next Thu. Need a concise partner SEV path. Proposal: shared channel (#shared-horizon-redwood) for updates, PagerDuty for P0, auto-bridge for P0, P1 handled in-channel w/30m SLA. Agree?
Raj: +1. Legal wants channel policy (allowed content = status, mitigation steps, links to runbook). No secrets in channel.
Marcos: I'll add a short runbook and a pinned snippet with fallback commands: route->quantized, clamp tokens, promote to dedicated.
Jade: Escalation flow suggestion: P0 -> OpsBot posts normalized alert + PD page -> bridge + tag partner liaison; P1 -> shared channel + tag liaison -> escalate to SRE if not ack in 30m.
Lina: Roles: Partner liaison=Jade, SRE on-call=Raj, Runbook owner=Marcos. Confirm?
Raj: Confirm. I'll own bridge and logs export checklist.
Marcos: I'll create runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/horizon-marketplace (internal) and include CLI snippets.
Jade: I'll draft the partner-facing header and channel topic. Also propose a dry-run Tue 09:00 PT.
OpsBot: DRY-RUN: fired simulated P0 (latency) -> posted normalized alert to #shared-horizon-redwood. alert=hc-dry-20260401-01 :rotating_light:
